busy.description: Whether the restaurant currently has an active busy interval.

busy_interval_id.description: Unique identifier of the busy interval.

start_time.description: When the busy interval begins, as an RFC-3339 / ISO-8601 UTC timestamp.

end_time.description: When the busy interval ends, as an RFC-3339 / ISO-8601 UTC timestamp.

eta_increase_seconds.description: Additional time, in seconds, added to the displayed delivery ETA while the restaurant is busy.

remaining_seconds.description: Seconds remaining until the busy interval ends (end_time).

PosBusyInterval.description: Details of the active busy interval, or null when the restaurant is not busy.
